VisDial models have been trained in one of two settings: discriminative or generative. In the discriminative setting, the model ranks a pool of answer candidates, whereas the generative setting additionally allows the model to generate the answers.

Following , we evaluate our model using the ranking metrics like Recall@K (K ∈ {1, 5, 10}), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), and Mean Rank, where only one answer is considered as correct. Since the 2018 VisDial challenge (after the acquisition of dense annotations), NDCG metric that considers the relevance degree of each answer candidate, has been adopted as the main metric to determine the winner.
